device.category: digitally controlled analogue monosynth (paraphonic option), 25 keys, with arpeggiator, sequencer and patch memory
device.based_on: Successor to the 1993 Novation Bass Station; released 2013, extended by firmware (AFX Station and Swifty editions share it).

architecture.polyphony_mode: monophonic; paraphonic mode gives two notes (one per oscillator) through the shared filter and VCA
architecture.patch_memory_note: 128 patches: 0-63 factory, 64-127 user (initially Init patches). Four global 32-step sequences; the selected one is stored in the patch. Eight banks of 25 AFX overlays, the selected bank stored in the patch. Nine tuning tables.
architecture.summary: Analogue signal path under digital control. Two oscillators (sine, triangle, saw, pulse) share one set of controls via OSC SELECT; a sub oscillator locks to Osc 1. Noise, ring mod (Osc 1 x Osc 2) and an external input share a fourth mixer level. Overdrive feeds a Classic multimode filter (LP/BP/HP, 12 or 24 dB) or an Acid 24 dB diode ladder; distortion follows the filter, then the VCA and limiter. Two ADSRs (Amp and Mod) share four faders; two LFOs have dedicated routings. Mod wheel, aftertouch and velocity reach set destinations via on-key functions. Arpeggiator, 4 x 32-step sequencer, AFX per-key overlays and micro-tuning.

modules.name: Keyboard and voice control
modules.description: 25 velocity-sensitive keys with aftertouch, octave shift -5/+4, transpose ±12 semitones, portamento with glide divergence, paraphonic mode, micro-tuning tables.

modules.name: Pitch and Mod wheels
modules.description: Spring-centred pitch wheel and mod wheel, both lit.

modules.name: Arpeggiator and sequencer
modules.description: Arpeggiator with 32 rhythms, 6 note orders and 1-4 octaves, 40-240 BPM or MIDI clock; also records and plays four 32-step sequences.

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: Analogue oscillator: sine, triangle, rising saw or pulse; range 16'-2', coarse ±12 semitones, fine ±100 cents; pulse width manual or modulated.

modules.name: Oscillator 2
modules.description: Analogue oscillator: sine, triangle, rising saw or pulse; range 16'-2', coarse ±12 semitones, fine ±100 cents; pulse width manual or modulated. Can be hard-synced to Osc 1, and can modulate the filter at audio rate (Osc Filter Mod).

modules.name: Sub oscillator
modules.description: One or two octaves below Osc 1 (and detunable from it); sine, narrow pulse or square.

modules.name: Ring modulator
modules.description: Ring modulation of Osc 1 and Osc 2.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: Six sources into one: Osc 1, Osc 2 and Sub with their own knobs; Noise, Ring and Ext share the fourth knob, chosen by switch, each keeping its own level.

modules.name: Filter
modules.description: Classic: variable LP, BP or HP at 12 or 24 dB/oct. Acid: fixed 4-pole (24 dB/oct) low-pass diode ladder, after early-1980s designs; Shape and Slope inactive.

modules.name: Distortion
modules.description: Post-filter, pre-VCA distortion, so its character does not change with the amplitude envelope.

modules.name: Amp Env
modules.description: ADSR always routed to the VCA; velocity sensitivity, triggering mode, optional retrigger loop and fixed-duration sustain.

modules.name: Mod Env
modules.description: ADSR for oscillator pitch, pulse width and filter frequency; same options as Amp Env.

modules.name: LFO 1
modules.description: Triangle, falling saw, square or sample and hold; 0 to about 190 Hz or synced; delay, slew and key sync. Routed to oscillator pitch.

modules.name: LFO 2
modules.description: Triangle, falling saw, square or sample and hold; 0 to about 190 Hz or synced; delay, slew and key sync. Routed to pulse width and filter frequency; aftertouch can change its speed.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Driven by Amp Env (scaled by velocity); includes a simple limiter.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: VOLUME sets line and headphone level; output is mono.

behaviours.name: Shared controls
behaviours.rule: OSC SELECT points the oscillator controls at Osc 1 or Osc 2 without changing the other. ENV SELECT points the faders and TRIGGERING at Amp, Mod or both. LFO DELAY/SPEED points the two LFO knobs at speed or delay. NOISE/RING/EXT points the fourth mixer knob at one of three sources, each keeping its level. The PULSE WIDTH switch picks whether the knob sets manual width, Mod Env depth or LFO 2 depth; all three act together.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Mixer, overdrive (before the filter), filter, distortion (after the filter, before the VCA, so it does not change with the envelope), VCA with limiter, VOLUME.

behaviours.name: Filter types
behaviours.rule: Classic: LP, BP or HP at 12 or 24 dB/oct, FREQUENCY being cutoff or band centre. Acid: 24 dB/oct diode-ladder low-pass; SHAPE and SLOPE do nothing.

behaviours.name: Modulation routing
behaviours.rule: LFO 1 only reaches oscillator pitch; LFO 2 reaches pulse width and filter frequency; Mod Env reaches pitch, pulse width and filter. The mod wheel and aftertouch reach their destinations by on-key amounts (-63 to +63); velocity scales Amp and Mod Env.

behaviours.name: Envelope triggering
behaviours.rule: Single: retriggers only on detached notes, glide on every note if GLIDE TIME is up. Multi: retriggers on every note. Autoglide: as Single but glides only on legato notes. Optional looping after decay (1-16 times or forever) and fixed-duration sustain for drum sounds.

behaviours.name: Paraphonic mode
behaviours.rule: Two held keys play Osc 1 and Osc 2 separately through one filter and VCA. Oscillator error then differs per oscillator.

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator and sequencer
behaviours.rule: Held notes play in the chosen order over 1-4 octaves to one of 32 rhythms; LATCH holds them. In RECORD, notes, rests (LATCH/REST) and ties/legato (ON/LEGATO) fill up to 32 steps in one of four sequences (lengths not recorded: RHYTHM sets the rhythm). In PLAY, the first key played sets the transposition. SEQ RETRIG restarts the sequence every two bars. Follows incoming MIDI clock automatically.

behaviours.name: AFX mode
behaviours.rule: An overlay bank gives each of the 25 home-octave keys its own set of parameter changes, recalled when the key plays: a different patch per key. Hold a key and move controls to edit its overlay; save the bank on its page. Eight banks (1-4 preset); FUNCTION + TRANSPOSE copies overlays between keys. Arpeggiator and global settings are not in overlays.

behaviours.name: On-key functions
behaviours.rule: Hold FUNCTION/EXIT and press a key (some keys pressed 2-4 times for extended functions), release, set with PATCH/VALUE, then FUNCTION/EXIT or a 10-second timeout. The keyboard keeps playing meanwhile.

behaviours.name: Memory
behaviours.rule: Edits are lost on patch change unless saved. MIDI channel, master tune and input gain are kept at power-off; Local resets to On; the synth starts on patch 0. A single patch received by SysEx loads into the edit buffer.

behaviours.name: Micro-tuning
behaviours.rule: Nine tuning tables (0 standard, 1-8 saved: prime, harmonic series, Indian shruti, Ptolemy, Bianzhong, Turkish, slendro/pelog, Carlos super just), editable by MIDI Tuning Standard SysEx; switching tables with glide up morphs between them.

source_inconsistencies: The box contents list a 12 V DC PSU; the power section and supplied PSU are 9 V DC 500 mA.
The envelope section says Mod Env reaches filter frequency 'when the filter is in Classic mode'; the filter section applies Mod Env depth to both types.
Aftertouch LFO 1 to Osc Pitch gives a maximum of 95 semitones 'or 8 octaves'; the mod wheel version gives 96.
Pitch Bend Range runs -24 to +24 on the panel but 1 to 12 in the MIDI chart.
The MIDI chart lists the mod wheel as CC 0 (bank select) rather than CC 1.
The init patch table has LFO 2 sync value 'on' but Speed/Sync LFO 2 'speed'.
Osc 2 manual pulse width runs 5 to 94.3 in the MIDI chart; Osc 1 runs 5 to 95.
Oscillators use a rising sawtooth; the LFOs use a falling one.

modelling_gaps.detail: Overlay contents (per-key parameter sets) are described, not modelled; the overlay parameter list is in the guide's appendix.
Each oscillator and envelope parameter is modelled separately, with the selector switch noted in its access.
Four global sequences of up to 32 steps are described in behaviours; their step data is not modelled as parameters.
